text:
Aisha: heads-up: customer saw provisional > confirmed after stream reconnect + toolcall retry. Sending repro.

Tom: paste trace when you have it.

Aisha: sanitized: req=cli-9a7f, events=[start, chunk(120), disconnect, resume(sid=s-842), chunk(40), toolcall(start,id=tc-11), toolcall(truncate), retry(toolcall,id=tc-11-r1), end], provisional=298, confirmed=190

Ravi: probable cause: truncated toolcall from first session counted, retry counted again because origin_session was dropped on handoff.

Sasha: router loses origin_session_id during compat handoff. Ledger can't dedupe.

Tom: short-term UX: show per-route "Tentative" badge with hover "Includes provisional tokens; finalizing in ~2m" so SREs don't panic.

Ravi: long-term: add `provisional` flag + `origin_session_id` and `toolcall_attempt_id` to telemetry/ledger events. Use (origin_session_id, token_end) for confirm dedupe. Also provisional TTL ~= 2m.

Sasha: I'll add shim to preserve origin_session on handoff (small patch).

ops-bot: canary deploy succeeded (router-shim e3b9f2) :white_check_mark:

Tom: add integration test for disconnect->resume->retry flows and a debug log when origin_session is dropped.

Aisha: assigned: Ravi=RFD, Sasha=shim+UX mock, Tom=tests+log. Thanks everyone.

Ravi: will draft RFD and hold refund policy until we see telemetry.
